paper_title: First results of the CAST-RADES haloscope search for axions at 34.67 $μ$eV
notes: First results of CAST-RADES haloscope at CERN. New measured exclusion limit on axion-photon coupling g_agamma >~ 4e-13 GeV^-1 (95% credibility level, Bayesian) over the narrow mass range 34.6738-34.6771 ueV (cavity resonance at 8.384 GHz). Assumes local DM density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 and standard isothermal halo (Maxwell-Boltzmann line shape, <v^2>^1/2 ~ 270 km/s). The stated limit is quoted as a single value across the narrow band; encoded as a flat two-point line.
